x: Tom Carter is still showing useful form for an old 'un, and it is to the younger element such as Mike Heard, Len Adams, Bragginton, Popplewell and Ches Walker, that we look to for support in the more serious races to come.
Mike Heard also ran well in finishing 40th and Arthur Bruce ran pluckily on a damaged foot to be 56th, with Eric Bishop 65, R.Garwood 112, L.C.Bishop 117, and L.A.Adams 138.
